Name: Spouse Cottages
Author: zzzzzzzhao
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]为每一位伴侣在农场上建造属于他们自己的家。
Build a home on your farm for each of your spouses.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]在罗宾的木匠商店建造配偶小屋，并为每间小屋指定一位已经结婚的伴侣。
Build spouse cottages at Robin’s Carpenter’s Shop and assign a married partner to each one.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]当前版本支持原版全部 12 位可婚角色，可在同一座农场建造多间小屋。
Supports all 12 vanilla marriage candidates, with multiple cottages on the same farm.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]每间小屋沿用对应角色婚后房间的装饰风格，搭配各具特色的家具布局与双人床。
Each cottage follows its resident’s original spouse-room style, with a distinct furniture layout and a double bed.

每天早上可以选择今晚邀请谁到农舍留宿。
The daily invitation menu lets you choose who will spend the night in your farmhouse.

只有当天受邀的伴侣会在夜间安排中使用农舍双人床，其余伴侣回各自的小屋休息。
Only the invited spouse is assigned to the farmhouse bed at night; the others sleep in their own cottages.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]保留玩家移动后的床、家具与箱内物品，让你继续布置每一个家。
Moved beds, furniture, and chest contents are preserved, so you can keep decorating each home.

请通过 SMAPI 启动游戏；同时拥有多位配偶时，需要搭配 Free Love。
Launch the game through SMAPI. Having multiple spouses requires a compatible marriage mod such as Free Love.[/color]

如果模组出现了bug，您可以在nexus内反馈给我，也可以到小红书反馈给我，我会及时修复。
